corrections: Translated and reread Strings/Locations source ordinals 224–255 directly from English, covering the mine shaft, signs, the Statue of Uncertainty, all three Dark Shrines, item recovery, Krobus eviction and Movie Theater posters.

Applied locked Guild, Stardew Valley, Pierre, profession, Prismatic Shard, Strange Bun, character and film terminology while preserving every placeholder, price, caret, asterisk, line break and boundary space.

Kept all shrine activation and deactivation consequences distinct, replaced a literal business-status calque with natural Bulgarian, and made the item-recovery and film-closing messages player-facing and concise.
